title: Non-blocking finding from PR #278's review (backend-static-verify-cleanup)
description: Tracked non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #278 (backend-static-verify-cleanup). Nothing here blocks the PR's accept; recorded so it isn't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: PR #278's description/commit message and the (untouched by this PR) task description/checklist text on backend-static-verify-cleanup all say the same slightly wrong thing: '5/6 I001 unsorted-import findings' listing six filenames including test_stooq_provider.py. Verified directly with `ruff check` against each file's pre-fix (main-branch) content: test_stooq_provider.py's only pre-existing finding was UP012 (unnecessary `.encode("utf-8")`) -- it had no I001 finding at all. The actual I001 set is the other five files (test_autoenvelope.py, test_elder_ray.py, test_force_index.py, test_rsi.py, test_stochastic.py). The total finding count (6 auto-fixable + 1 F841 = 7) is correct and every code fix applied is correct -- this is purely a wording slip, originating in the task's own description (carried over from PR #277) and repeated in PR #278's body/commit message without being caught or corrected, even though the PR's own new `decisions` entry (which does correctly single out UP012 vs I001 when explaining the ruff-scope rationale) implicitly contradicts the description/checklist text sitting right above it in the same file. No code or task-board functional field needs changing. If revisited: correct the task's own description/checklist text via a fresh note (per CLAUDE.md's decisions-array append-only-correction convention, since this task is now done) rather than editing it in place, and correct PR #278's description via an additive PR comment (per CLAUDE.md's 'Correcting a stale claim in an already-merged PR's description' section) rather than editing the merged PR body in place.
